# Lingolia English

> Lingolia English is a comprehensive free online platform for learning and practicing English grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension across all CEFR levels (A1-B2).

The platform offers interactive grammar lessons, vocabulary training, reading and listening exercises, and a verb conjugator tool. Content is available in multiple languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian) to serve learners worldwide, with premium Lingolia Plus subscriptions available for enhanced learning.

## Key Topics

- English Grammar
- Verb Tenses
- Grammar Exercises
- CEFR Levels (A1, A2, B1, B2)
- Vocabulary Training
- Reading Practice
- Listening Comprehension
- Interactive Learning
- Grammar Rules
- Writing Skills
- Pronouns and Determiners
- Adjectives
- Nouns
- Articles
- Phrasal Verbs

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Learn and practise English with Lingolia](https://english.lingolia.com/en): Main English learning platform offering free grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension content
- [English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar): Comprehensive English grammar guide covering tenses, pronouns, articles, and prepositions
- [English Vocabulary](https://english.lingolia.com/en/vocabulary): Themed vocabulary lists with idioms, numbers, dates, and interactive practice exercises
- [English Reading and Listening Practice](https://english.lingolia.com/en/listening-reading): A2-B2 level reading and listening materials with comprehension exercises

## Grammar Reference & Lessons

- [Verb Tenses in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/tenses): Complete guide to 12 English verb tenses with aspects and practice exercises
- [Comparison of Verb Tenses in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/tense-comparison): Detailed comparison of simple, progressive, and perfect English tenses
- [Verbs in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/verbs): Comprehensive guide to verbs, auxiliaries, modals, and phrasal verbs
- [Nouns in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/nouns): Guide to English nouns covering countable, uncountable, and possessive forms
- [Articles in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/articles): Explanation of indefinite (a/an) and definite (the) article usage rules
- [Pronouns and Determiners in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/pronouns-determiners): Guide to pronouns and determiners as parts of English speech
- [Adjectives in English Grammar](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/adjectives): Adjective guide covering placement, order, and usage in English
- [Punctuation](https://english.lingolia.com/en/writing-school): English punctuation guide covering commas, apostrophes, and quotation marks

## Interactive Tools & Assessment

- [What's your English level? Take the free test](https://english.lingolia.com/en/test): Free online CEFR English grammar level assessment with immediate results
- [Conjugate English Verbs](https://english.lingolia.com/en/grammar/conjugator): Interactive English verb conjugator tool for all tenses and forms
- [The Lingolia Top 15 for English](https://english.lingolia.com/en/top): Curated list of 15 most popular English grammar lessons and exercises
